title: Tool 74 — DLT Settlement Verifier
description: Paste Corda or Canton settlement transaction JSON to decode state machine transitions, verify WebCrypto signatures, map ISO 20022 fields, and verify iso20022Hash (keccak256 vs SHA-256). Pass/fail report with Policy Mandate. Client-side. Zero PII.
